name: Utilities
description: Single-purpose overrides with !important. Use sparingly; reach for a layout or component first.

classes.name: u-margin-0
classes.description: Remove margin, e.g. from a heading or paragraph inside a component.

classes.name: u-sr-only
classes.description: Visually hidden but read by screen readers.

use: u-sr-only for accessible labels on icon-only controls.
avoid: Stacking several utilities to restyle a component; add a modifier to its contract instead.
